area: Massif, rock wall, terrace and junction synthesis: the falsification record and the laws that limit synthesizing new landmasses (Path D wall arc, V-shore arc, massif_synth, terrace wall, dunes/beach mints, R4 west-seam, the affine-carry rungs, prefabs)

laws.name: THE DEFECT FOLLOWS THE AUTHORSHIP
laws.statement: Owner-named defects land on whatever surface the round most recently authored. None land on carried stock geometry that sits in its own context.
laws.evidence: 12 of 13 playtest verdicts and 32 of 37 named defects on the Path-D wall arc. Replicated in the V-shore arc (the tuck rebuild deleted 332 authored tris, leaving 14, and the defects ended) and on R4 west-seam (every rejection over 12 takes landed on the take's own minted foot-course tris, while the ~300 deg of carried perimeter passed on first deploy).
laws.scope_measured: One bench (the Path-D (416,-512) island, six blocks), one owner, about 13 verdicts. Replicated on the V-shore corner and the R4 massif foot.
laws.scope_applied: CLAUDE.md section 7 applies it project-wide. PREFABS.md uses it to justify 'a prefab mints no new surface after its walk'.
laws.source: studies/path-d-new-world/GROUND-JUNCTION-SYNTHESIS.md 'S0 - THE ANSWER'; memory project-ff9-ground-junction-synthesis.md (R4 loop paragraph); SEGMENT-TRANSPLANT-PREDICTION.md 'THE TUCK REBUILD'

laws.name: A GREEN GATE SUITE IS A REGRESSION HARNESS, NOT AN ORACLE (0 of 13)
laws.statement: Gates that score an element against stock's marginal distributions cannot tell whether stock ever builds that shape.
laws.evidence: No gate fired before the owner's eye in 13 verdicts. A 10.94u weld displacement passed a 12u cap and the owner named it. Revised later: after the render gate and the peer gate, 4 defects were caught offline before deploy and 2 found by the owner (SEGMENT-TRANSPLANT 'The gate record, honestly'). REPORT.md: the next three owner verdicts after the render gate all passed.
laws.scope_measured: Marginal-scoring gates before the render gate, Path-D wall arc only.
laws.scope_applied: Cited project-wide (CLAUDE.md section 7) with no note that pixel and peer gates changed the record.

laws.name: THE FORM LESSON
laws.statement: Statistics reproduce rock texture organization's measured properties, never its look. Real content pushed through a synthetic frame is still synthesis.
laws.evidence: massif_synth.py: 8 rounds in one day (2026-07-13), each fixing a correctly diagnosed defect class and minting a new one. Final words: 'very confused about where the grass goes ... patchwork ... stretching'. Later instances: the v3 bend-carry, the dunes label-stamp, the beach ladder.
laws.scope_measured: Rock: one grass bench (seed-42 islet, block (2,19)), Uaho-scale sheet-class mountain, no render/peer gate, no decoded foot grammar. Other instances are their own families.
laws.scope_applied: CLAUDE.md section 8 bans from-scratch massif synthesis outright and extends the ban to any texture organization.

laws.name: THE ROCK-RIGID / AFFINE-CARRY LAW
laws.statement: Carried rock may deform only by a declared global affine map: de-tilt, translate, any-angle rotation, plan spread up to x1.5, pure-Y rock-height up to x2.0. MTN_ROCK_RIGID 0.035 refuses any undeclared deformation.
laws.evidence: Owner-passed: --rot any angle (round 16), --spread x1.5 ('B, C and D all read as stock mountains', round 20), --rock-height x2.0 on Uaho ('2x honestly doesn't look bad'), forest --spread x1.5 kept. The lower bounds are policy only: interior.py:2044-2046 'lower is untested'.
laws.scope_measured: Uaho, comp20 and the desert peak (mountains); five canopies; one camera per variant.
laws.scope_applied: Every world-mountain / world-forest / world-fuse [[mountain]] row. Applied ranges: spread 1.0-1.5, height 1.0-2.0 (interior.py:57,138-142,762,2194).

laws.name: THE OVERHANG-CONTEXT LAW
laws.statement: A verbatim stock element can be wrong because of the context it was taken from, not because the carry was inexact.
laws.evidence: 5 of 5 grass-family coast lips overhang (seaward ny -0.37..-0.15). Over a cut sea they hang over dry void; owner: 'more segmented and fractured ... less than 90 degree angle'. Every auxiliary the overhang forced was new authored surface.
laws.scope_measured: Grass-family coast lips carried onto a cut-sea shore (the V-corner, playtest 10).
laws.scope_applied: NEXT-STUDIES carry-forward law 1, generalized: 'verbatim is not automatically safe'. Enforced in meshedit.sweep_wall (a test catches its removal).
laws.source: memory project-ff9-overhang-context-law.md; SEGMENT-TRANSPLANT-PREDICTION.md playtest 10; NEXT-STUDIES.md P1 table

laws.name: SCORE AGAINST THE NEIGHBOUR (the peer gate)
laws.statement: Judge a new element against owner-accepted peers rendered from identical relative cameras, not against stock's marginals.
laws.evidence: The corner's rock-band variation was 0.32 vs the peer median 0.35, and it passed in game. THE WRONG REFERENCE: a clone scored against its donor's paint passed and was tonally wrong.
laws.scope_measured: One island's coast (the V-shore corner plus four owner-passed stations).
laws.scope_applied: meshedit.cover_gap's tone reference; proposed as a general method. NEXT-STUDIES asks whether it stays meaningful once most of the coast is minted.
laws.source: memory project-ff9-overhang-context-law.md 'THE PEER GATE'; NEXT-STUDIES.md P4 open question

laws.name: THE TAPER LAW
laws.statement: Every real stock wall endpoint tapers to ground or closes into a ring. A wall that 'just stops' does not exist. The row-10 foot band never reaches a tip.
laws.evidence: 42 of 42 real crest endpoints taper. 134 of 179 raw endpoints were block-border truncations. 0 band tris within 9u of a tip vs 1307 mid-run. 3 closed rings, all mesas.
laws.scope_measured: Interior topo-49 crest-seeded walls, 48 blocks / 62 components, disc 1. No endpoint at a coast.
laws.scope_applied: Closed the minted-plan wall lane (cut windows mint endpoints). The CURTAIN study notes it never measured coast endpoints.
laws.source: studies/path-d-new-world/ENDPOINT-GRAMMAR.md E1-E3; CURTAIN-GRAMMAR.md 'What is already in hand'

laws.name: THE DISPLACED-ROW LAW (rim)
laws.statement: Stock never clips the plateau lattice at a crest. The outermost lattice row is displaced onto the crest (one row deep). Ring-1 tris stay full half-cells, and crest segments are never shorter than a cell.
laws.evidence: Crest plan residual med 0.80u vs ring-1 inner boundary med 0.0. Ring-1 area med 7.5 vs 8.0u2. Segment p25 4.00u. Turns 82% under 30 deg. Crest y wander +/-0.7u.
laws.scope_measured: 62 components / 951 crest edges, interior walls, disc 1.
laws.scope_applied: The rim-aware build (its Delaunay displaced-row top was banked as plateau-mint machinery). Implied for any minted plateau.

laws.name: J1-J3 JUNCTION LAWS (crest / corner / foot)
laws.statement: Crest: no cap row, the plateau is level behind a 52.5 deg face, every top once-edge is welded. Corner: corners are full ordinary columns creased at a shared edge, and mirroring rises with the turn angle (6% to 60%). Foot: weld to level plain ground with no pierce and no talus. The transition art lives on the wall's bottom row (row 10).
laws.evidence: 951 crest tris, 9682 instance pairs. Foot edges 96.7% welded. Foot ground outward slope med 0.00.
laws.scope_measured: Escarpment-class interior walls (48 blocks / 62 comps).
laws.scope_applied: Junction-aware and rim-aware strip carries. The foot clause is later contradicted by S5, the PROFILE LAW and the full-skirt overlay (see tensions).

laws.name: THE BAND-CONTINUATION LAW
laws.statement: A wall's transitional bottom band is never placed. It is the column's own uv continued (100% u- and v-continuous; v seam 10.16 copied on both sides; 71% of band on/off transitions carry u straight through).
laws.evidence: 1,090 seam verts with zero exceptions; 904 course seams / 846 side edges.
laws.scope_measured: Interior wall bottom courses (48 blocks / 62 comps).
laws.scope_applied: Wall bases; named as the break in R4 takes 5-12, which stationed foot u by arc length. Does NOT govern curtains (0 of 1490 continuous, CURTAIN C2).

laws.name: S5 THE APPROACH-GROUND LAW
laws.statement: Stock ground at a wall foot is a short lip, then a LEVEL terrace at a sustained ~1.0-1.5u offset over local lowland. It is never a ramp and never a pedestal, and a calm host is a real ~10% subpopulation.
laws.evidence: 0 of 176 components are pedestals. Slope by band 0.5/0.7/1.3/-0.1/0.5 deg. 17 of 176 sit on ground spanning <=4.15u within 50.6u. It was the only one of six laws whose build implication survived its skeptic.
laws.scope_measured: 176 stock rock components, disc 1.
laws.scope_applied: Convicts both BURY and LIFT-with-falloff seats. Bounds the owner's 'smooth transition' option A in the V-shore round.
laws.source: GROUND-JUNCTION-SYNTHESIS.md 'THE ONE LAW THAT SURVIVED ITS SKEPTIC'

laws.name: GATE T: the tessellation envelope
laws.statement: Stock grass never exceeds 4-5 tris per 4u cell (median tri ~8u2). Per-vertex reconciliation that shatters the sheet is off-language and also generates tears.
laws.evidence: Live bench: 4,181 tris at median 0.32u2, max 82 per cell, 107 tris over 45 deg, 15 edges above the climb ceiling. Pristine: 858 tris, max 5. bench_audit.py is red on the faulted build and green on pristine and stock.
laws.scope_measured: Grass class; one bench vs stock.
laws.scope_applied: The banked gate for any ground junction.

laws.name: GROUND NORMALS ARE RENDER-INERT
laws.statement: WorldMap/Terrain binds only vertex + texcoord and has no light position. WMMesh.Normals is read at zero non-debug sites, and the walk query recomputes normals geometrically.
laws.evidence: Engine source read during the synthesis study. Round 8's normal pass could not change a pixel.
laws.scope_measured: Terrain shader and the WMMesh read sites.
laws.scope_applied: No normal gate and no shading rounds. This also means synthesized ground needs no lawful normals for LOOK (the walk recomputes them).

laws.name: RENDER-ONLY SKIP TAGS (4078/4088/2040)
laws.statement: WMPhysics.Raycast skips any tri whose first-corner tangent.x is 4078, 4088 or 2040. Such a surface renders but never answers a ground query, and re-tagging changes zero pixels.
laws.evidence: WMPhysics.cs:15-20, read firsthand and double-verified. The underlay round restored 'one walk-visible surface per plan point' without deleting a tri. Walk was stock-correct across three playtests.
laws.scope_measured: The walk query and ring cache. Recorded exposures: the NPC re-ground path and vehicle get-off.
laws.scope_applied: Only the Path-D bench underlay (LAWN-CLIP). Not folded into world-mountain.

laws.name: SEA4-UNDER-LAND / THE SINGLE-WALK-SHEET INVARIANT
laws.statement: Ground under ground captures the walk ray and the movement cache. The cache path WMBlock.cs:155 -> WMPhysics.cs:49 applies no up-facing or topograph filter.
laws.evidence: Full-skirt overlay playtest 2: 'Zidane appears at a fixed height, able to walk through hills'. Fixed by the 4078 underlay.
laws.scope_measured: Overlay junctions on the Path-D bench; engine source.
laws.scope_applied: Any overlapping-sheet construction, including prefabs that stack relief on a mint.

laws.name: WALK LIMITS: the climb ceiling, the up-facing filter, the canopy sink
laws.statement: Climb ceiling 2.34375u (canopy 1.171875). The full scan skips tris with ny <= 0.1. Rock topo-49 is foot-illegal through the s_moveCHRControl.limit topograph mask.
laws.evidence: Walk-query decode; the overworld walk gate decoded during massif_synth; terrain._walk_gate (defect 23).
laws.scope_measured: Engine source.
laws.scope_applied: Every synthesized ground/rock surface: vertical curtains are walk-invisible by construction, and minted topo-49 blocks movement like real rock.
laws.source: memory project-ff9-overworld-interior-topography.md:546-549; memory project-ff9-terrain-malleability-study.md (2026-10-08 entry); CURTAIN-GRAMMAR.md VERDICT

laws.name: THE CURTAIN CONSTRUCTION + HOVER-OVER-GROUND = 0
laws.statement: Stock seals every raised rim with plan-degenerate vertical quads whose topograph continues the surface above, on a dedicated pinned atlas strip per family, with the bottom verts welded into the ground. No hovering edge over ground exists.
laws.evidence: 159 curtain components / 2,703 tris, 97% zero once-edge. 0 of 2,928 free edges hover over ground (positive control detected). Forest strip v 930/961 pinned, drop domain 1.668-2.863u.
laws.scope_measured: 260 disc-1 terrain blocks, 122 coastal blocks.
laws.scope_applied: The V-shore curtain seal, which then FAILED on context: the forest strip is the canopy wall of a forest resting against a mountain, not a generic seal.
laws.source: CURTAIN-GRAMMAR.md C1-C3; VSHORE-SEAL-PREDICTION.md playtest 1 + 'THE OWNER'S DECODE'

laws.name: THE FREE-BASE LAW + ROCK NEVER DIVES
laws.statement: Coastal face bases never land on walkable terrain; they terminate free at or below the waterline. Interior rock never descends below water (0 of 311). A topo-58 coastal-cliff curtain carries the last stretch down.
laws.evidence: Coast-mosaic pillar D; CURTAIN C3: a seal at 90% of ~80 wall-meets-coast junctions.
laws.scope_measured: Disc-1 coasts.
laws.scope_applied: Every minted coast (world-island rim walls); killed the FREE DESCENT option.
laws.source: memory project-ff9-overworld-coast-mosaic.md LAW INDEX line 113; CURTAIN-GRAMMAR.md C3

laws.name: THE MASSING LAWS (50 degrees; the silhouette is the carrier)
laws.statement: Interior walls batter at med 50.1 deg (not the coastal 73). Courses weld coplanar, ledges are sparse deep features, the foot is smooth (1% right angles), and the per-column profile wobble is organic. Massing, not tiles, carries the look.
laws.evidence: rock_wall_massing.py, decoded after terrace round 2 failed. Profile-carry (carried silhouettes) earned the first positive form verdict for a synthetic wall.
laws.scope_measured: Interior escarpment walls, disc 1.
laws.scope_applied: The reason the tile-language lane closed. Any future synthesis rung must start from a massing decode (SYNTHESIS-RECONSIDERED postscript).

laws.name: THE INSTANCE LAWS + THE MIRROR GRADIENT
laws.statement: LAW 1: v-orientation is fixed per tile (54 of 62 at >=90%). LAW 2: u-mirroring is rare overall (12.5%) but concentrated at turns (6-11% at 0-45 deg up to 60% at 120+). LAW 3: a wall column is a contiguous vertical atlas strip capped by a measured crest table.
laws.evidence: 8945 instances (count reproduces the first decode); 9682 pairs for the gradient.
laws.scope_measured: Interior walls, 48 blocks.
laws.scope_applied: Terrace round 2. Profile-carry showed transition-tile orientation is conditioned on geometry (an untested hypothesis).

laws.name: ROCK TEXTURE DIALECTS (mural vs tile language vs continuous flow)
laws.statement: Big escarpment walls wear quantized 128px tiles, one per ~4.7u quad. Small sheet mountains (Uaho) have ZERO full-tile quads: sub-tile windows of one continuous atlas flow, one row per 2.6u. Within the right row band the column choice is cosmetically free (COL-FREEDOM), and rows are load-bearing.
laws.evidence: rock_wall_language.py; uaho_anatomy.py; massif_tweak1 probe A (column break) invisible in game, probe B (row break) visible. UV-10 correction: the BAKED-TERRAIN 'mural' uniqueness metric fails its negative control (rock art shared map-wide, ~29% exact tiles).
laws.scope_measured: Escarpment walls (48 blocks); Uaho (block (0,0)); Daguerreo.
laws.scope_applied: Contradictory labels are still used: cut_census 'crosses-baked-terrain' (mural), the terrace rung (tile language), massif synth v3 (continuous flow).
laws.source: studies/overworld-topography/README.md:120-161 + 1074-1121; memory project-ff9-overworld-coast-mosaic.md LAW INDEX line 92; memory project-ff9-overworld-interior-topography.md:497-505

laws.name: MOGURI-GUTTER / TILE-RECT CONTAINMENT
laws.statement: The atlas has transparent tile gutters. Any land-tri uv crossing a tile edge smears in game, while edge-touching is safe. A land tri's uv image must sit inside one source tile rect.
laws.evidence: massif_synth fix rounds 2-4 ('big grass seam'); the promontory shards (coast-mosaic 2026-08-04). The offline sampler skipped transparent texels and could not see it.
laws.scope_measured: Moguri atlas; land families.
laws.scope_applied: Every synthesized uv. Water is exempt (the self-tiling sheet).

laws.name: THE SMOOTH-FIELD LAW
laws.statement: Synthesized uv fields must follow the smooth shape height at (x,z), never the jittered vertex y. Jitter reversals fold the sampled strip into chevrons; crags must show through geometry.
laws.evidence: massif_synth v3 round 1: 'very warped and stretched' (chevron banding).
laws.scope_measured: Synthetic sheet massif, one bench.
laws.scope_applied: Banked as transferable to carry seams.

laws.name: THE LAWN-LINE LAW + fringe v-seam unification
laws.statement: Stock seats every row-10 fringe contact edge on the tile's painted lawn line (1037 of 1044 within 0.02 tile). Fringe v-seams (stock 6 of 2,536) sit only on contact tris.
laws.evidence: Uaho U5 SE-end failure ('cliff hits the grass with no transition tile'). Two of the three map-wide exceptions are Uaho's own home tris, hidden at home and exposed on open lawn. world-mountain now snaps (R5b) and unifies (R5c).
laws.scope_measured: Map-wide fringe contacts.
laws.scope_applied: world-mountain zip contacts (UV only).

laws.name: THE PROFILE LAW (base continues the face)
laws.statement: Marching uphill from each rock-grass contact: A1 (envelope angle 0-8u) p25-p75 is 42-53 deg with floor p05 33 deg. Kink = A1 minus (angle 8-16u), stock range -6..+18. The base continues the face above as a convex toe. Where the body above is flat, build no wall; retreat the contact.
laws.evidence: n=926 stock feet. The R4 failed window was the massif's only out-of-law zone. Per-tri slope stats matched stock in every rejected take.
laws.scope_measured: Disc-1 massif feet.
laws.scope_applied: Declared the GATE for any base/junction authoring.

laws.name: THE FOREST-CONTEXT RULE (canopy-foot)
laws.statement: A rock face that stood behind a forest at home reads wrong bare (its rim sits at canopy height, ~1.5u). Flag raised forest contacts. A canopy step is a walled canopy the rock meets; carry the whole canopy component.
laws.evidence: The R4 failed arc = the one 29u run whose donor rim touched forest at home (chance 6.8%). H-datum falsified by an owner-approved raised coastal-rock Uaho stretch. comp26 qualified with an alcove_floor canopy.
laws.scope_measured: The horseshoe, Uaho, the Path-D mesa; 5 of 28 massifs meet canopy.
laws.scope_applied: Donor screening for carries and prefabs (PREFABS.md 'Canopy vs rock').
laws.source: memory project-ff9-ground-junction-synthesis.md (FOREST OR DATUM / RESOLVED); memory project-ff9-terrain-malleability-study.md round 22

laws.name: THE CANOPY CARRY LAW
laws.statement: Carry a real canopy blob whole; never synthesize it. Canopy texture is hand-authored, with 28-35 non-affine UV patches.
laws.evidence: Two synthesis attempts falsified in game (per-tri tile picks; dome + jitter + tiles, 'a sloppy triangular mess').
laws.scope_measured: Two rounds, one bench, July 2026, before the curtain construction was decoded.
laws.scope_applied: world-forest carries only.

laws.name: THE LABEL-STAMP FALLACY
laws.statement: A verbatim stamp must carry the MESH (verts + per-corner UVs + tangents), not row labels painted onto a synthetic frame.
laws.evidence: The whole-stamp dunes mint at (1248,-1184) was rejected as 'castellated'. Byte A/B: boundary 100% on grid vs stock 14.6% off-grid, every ecotone tile at ori 0, UVs byte-derived for 2.1% of cells. The true mesh carry got 'The ecotone is nice now'.
laws.scope_measured: The dunes|desert ecotone, 130-cell comp[1].
laws.scope_applied: CLAUDE.md section 8, generalized to 'real content through a synthetic frame is still synthesis'.

laws.name: THE DUNES SIZE-CLASS LAW
laws.statement: The dunes family has a minimum size class (about 130 cells or more). Small dune blobs do not exist in FF9, and stock arrangement quilts on a ~31-cell blob.
laws.evidence: The shape census found zero components smaller than the two real ones (273/130 cells). In the round-4 'transplant control' (comp[0]'s ordered boundary walk), genuine stock arrangement quilted at small size.
laws.scope_measured: The census is solid. The control was a per-cell LABEL transplant, the mechanism round 5 later convicted.
laws.scope_applied: PREFABS.md: 'there is no small dunes prefab'.

laws.name: THE WALL-CONTEXT LAW (fail-closed)
laws.statement: A minted island's rim is a sea cliff, so its ground family must have measured open-sea coastal wall usage. Families with no measurement are refused, the same as measured interior-only ones.
laws.evidence: Census: canyon's red-band wall has 0 open-sea coastal faces. The gate was made fail-closed on 2026-07-19 after scrub/brush/dunes slipped through as None.
laws.scope_measured: Canyon is measured. Scrub, brush and dunes are NOT measured.
laws.scope_applied: island.py:425-445 and transplant.py:744-757 refuse every unmeasured family. SYNTHESIS-RECONSIDERED calls it a design choice on a new world.
laws.source: ff9mapkit/ff9mapkit/world/island.py:425-445; studies/path-d-new-world/SYNTHESIS-RECONSIDERED.md 'What the blank canvas GENUINELY buys' item 3

laws.name: THE ONE-SITE WORLD LAW
laws.statement: Exhaustive enumeration of the 480 lattice centres: the stock world contains exactly one R>=125 open site for the junction_compose-donor-sized two-ground landmass. The best other site is 115.38u.
laws.evidence: Occupancy enumeration under the whole-block shift law (centres pinned to cx=32, cz=0 mod 64). 'A second ... needs a smaller donor window or a de-deployed bench -- an owner decision, not a code gap.'
laws.scope_measured: One donor size (R>=125), stock disc-1 occupancy.
laws.scope_applied: CLAUDE.md section 10 states it as 'the map holds exactly one landmass of this class'. PREFABS proposes max_per_world=1. No kit code enforces it (a grep of ff9mapkit/ for one-site / max_per_world finds nothing).

laws.name: THE OPEN-OCEAN TARGET LAW
laws.statement: A transplant or prefab target must be true open ocean, with no per-block mesh assets. A real target refuses without allow_real_target.
laws.evidence: The (5,2)/(6,2) incident (a clobbered real block).
laws.scope_measured: A safety incident, not a look measurement.
laws.scope_applied: Every transplant, plus the prefab clear-window check. It keeps a prefab's only context its own sea ring, which is what lets one walk qualify every site.
laws.source: memory project-ff9-overworld-coast-mosaic.md LAW INDEX line 43; PREFABS.md 'The laws that bound a prefab catalog'

laws.name: THE FUSE LAW
laws.statement: Land never knits: coastlines are components. Water knits: sea4-to-sea4 borders are always legal.
laws.evidence: Coast-mosaic fuse census; R4 coast-join (the horseshoe's home coast meets the minted cliff 1.3-1.9u lower, the hard class).
laws.scope_measured: Disc-1 coasts and fuse layouts.
laws.scope_applied: world-fuse frame certification. The deep reason minted islands succeed: their only junction is water.
laws.source: coast-mosaic LAW INDEX line 93; memory project-ff9-ground-junction-synthesis.md (COAST-JOIN-STUDY)

laws.name: THE WHOLE-BLOCK IDENTITY LAW (prefab frame)
laws.statement: A framed mint plus its carries is byte- or triangle-identical under any whole-64u-block shift. A 4u or 32u shift re-clips cells and gives different land.
laws.evidence: Measured offline over 14 configs and 81 files. Fingerprint by triangle multiset at float32. desert-peak-isle walked at (10,9).
laws.scope_measured: build_landmass grass/desert/snow + world-forest + world-hill + world-mountain (desert peak), two sites 128u apart.
laws.scope_applied: world-prefab snaps placement to blocks; one walk qualifies every site. Rotation and --target-disc are unmeasured.

laws.name: THE GRASS-HILL LANGUAGE + THE ROLLING-RELIEF ENVELOPE
laws.statement: Lowland slope p99 28.6 deg. Pure-grass summits are real: prominence 3.5-5.2u over 20-26u, peaks <= ~8.6. Calm-plain residual std 0.46-1.07u, decorrelation ~9-12u. A hill footprint must sit inside a 2.4u y-span, never on prior displacement.
laws.evidence: census.py + calib_relief.py. Relief amp 1.3 gives std ~0.58, slope p99 ~11 deg.
laws.scope_measured: Disc-1 grass/desert lowland.
laws.scope_applied: world-hill, build_landmass relief_amp (opt-in, default flat).

laws.name: THE MOAT LAW v2
laws.statement: Walkable synthetic ground ends at least ~4u inland of the outline. Otherwise a corridor dead-ends in the Sea4 lap zone and traps the player.
laws.evidence: Island F round 3: the player was stuck at the west mouth.
laws.scope_measured: One synthetic island corridor.
laws.scope_applied: The terrace wall registration and any minted coast.

laws.name: THE NO-FREE-MESA LAW / ISLAND COROLLARY
laws.statement: No free-standing flat-topped mesa exists on disc 1, and no small sea-ringed landmass has walkable highland. All high country is on the one 97-block continent.
laws.evidence: v4 transplant census; the ~96% rim figure was softened 2026-07-18 because no committed script backs it.
laws.scope_measured: Disc-1 landmass components.
laws.scope_applied: Steered the v4 transplant. Contested by ENDPOINT-GRAMMAR E3/E4 (see tensions).

laws.name: HEIGHT CEILING (airship)
laws.statement: The tallest stock terrain vertex is y 42.68 and the airship flies at 42.1875. Taller rock traps the airship inside it.
laws.evidence: Terrain-study vertical census + airship altitude.
laws.scope_measured: Disc-1 stock terrain.
laws.scope_applied: Bounds rock-height on tall donors (the x2.0 cap is the binding one today).

falsified.what: From-scratch synthetic SHEET MASSIF (massif_synth.py)
falsified.how_it_failed: 8 playtests in one day, each rejected. The named classes moved each round: unclear base transition, no upward grain (r1); 'still a mess' (r2); chevrons (v3 r1); grass seam + stretch (Moguri gutters, r2-4); then 'cuts are clean and density looks nice' (the face window mechanics APPROVED), with the residue at the transition band. Rounds 7-8: 'very confused about where the grass goes ... patchwork ... stretching'. Closed as THE FORM LESSON.
falsified.what_exactly_was_tested: Pure-Y cone displacement of a deployed grass lattice (zero topology change), minted topo-49, a retile from Daguerreo exemplar quads. Then 6 radial ridgelines + hash jitter. Then the v3 Uaho recipe: offset summit + knoll, 47 deg flanks to a 20 deg apron, 2u subdivision, a continuous UV field with apex freeze, cylindrical per-course u, inset windows, a downhill-arc v. Rounds 7-8 swapped in coherent az-wander tongues, contour-aligned fringe and perp3d v-windows. One bench: the seed-42 patchless islet, block (2,19), world (160,-1248), grass, Uaho scale.
falsified.what_was_NOT_tested: The foot grammar decoded LATER and never applied to a synthetic face: BAND-CONTINUATION (2026-07-31), THE LAWN-LINE LAW + v-seam unify (2026-10-07), THE PROFILE LAW (convex toe, kink -6..+18). Also untested: the render gate and peer gate (they did not exist yet); a synthetic face joined to a CARRIED foot/apron; the escarpment tile dialect; desert or snow ground; any bench but one; massing taken from a real silhouette rather than an invented cone + ridgelines. tensions: THE FORM LESSON is stated as 'rock texture organization cannot be synthesized', but the massif_synth record shows the face window mechanics were APPROVED in game ('cuts are clean and density looks nice'). The arc died on the grass/rock FOOT, a junction class that later defeated a CARRIED massif too (R4: 0 for 12) until THE BAND-CONTINUATION, LAWN-LINE and PROFILE laws were decoded. The falsification is confounded with an undecoded junction. A synthetic face built to today's foot laws has never been tried.

The terrace-wall refutation of THE DISCRIMINANT assumes round 2 'faithfully implemented the language'. Yet terrace_wall_t1.py:909-915 still uses the int(-cz//4) cell key that terrace_wall_strip.py:2344-2351 later proved collapses mains u (decode 0/354). One of the five named defects (the banded top) was plumbing, and the scoring's lesson 2 ('a dead-flat shelf bands even under lawful mains') is a misattribution. The flat island mints that pass (island E, prefabs) contradict that lesson directly.

The DUNES SIZE-CLASS LAW's 'closure proof' (stock arrangement quilts at ~31 cells) used per-cell label transplants. Round 5 later showed that mechanism castellates at 130 cells too (100% on-grid boundary, ori-0). Scale and mechanism are confounded. The census half (no small dune components exist) stands, but it is an absence, not proof that a small one would fail.

Carry purity versus affine stretching: GROUND-JUNCTION-SYNTHESIS convicts the panel's 1.44 deg de-tilt (1.65u of motion on carried bytes) as violating carry purity 'at 27x the magnitude'. world-mountain meanwhile ships THE DE-TILT (an affine shear of the whole blob, ~1.5% texel distortion), and the owner passed x2 rock-height and x1.5 spread. The real line is global smooth affine (passes) vs per-vertex or ribbon reparameterization (fails), not 'never move carried bytes'.

CLAUDE.md section 8 still says 'real content through a synthetic frame is still synthesis'. SYNTHESIS-RECONSIDERED shows that wording forbids the rigid carry-in-synthetic-frame hybrid that works (Rung F, the mesa, prefabs). The line was never corrected at its source.

'Synthesis from vocabulary constants fails' (the fairing rounds, the curtain mint) vs 'synthesis from vocabulary constants passes' (THE TUCK, the cliff re-skin, world-island's coast columns). The difference is that the constants were measured on the IMMEDIATE NEIGHBOUR the element must join, not on stock's map-wide marginals. That is SCORE AGAINST THE NEIGHBOUR applied at generation time, and no law states it.

Rock texture has three incompatible labels in force: hand-painted MURAL (BAKED-TERRAIN, whose uniqueness metric failed its negative control per UV-10), exact-linear TILE LANGUAGE (rock_wall_language), and CONTINUOUS FLOW with zero full-tile quads (Uaho). These are probably scale/class dialects, but the gates (cut_census crosses-baked-terrain) and the bans (FORM LESSON) do not say which dialect they assume.

THE NO-FREE-MESA LAW (no free-standing flat-topped mesa on disc 1, rim-ringed ~96%, stat uncommitted) contradicts ENDPOINT-GRAMMAR E3/E4: the (15,14) mesa is a pure closed crest ring with an enclosed plateau and boundary = crest weld + ground only, ZERO rock edges. Round 2 of the July mesa carry also listed six carryable mesas. There is no reconciliation census.

Foot laws disagree because their class scope is unstated. J3: level plain ground, no talus, no pierce, outward slope 0.00. S5: a sustained 1.0-1.5u terrace offset. Uaho anatomy: grass climbs ~2.5u up a ~20 deg shoulder, no flat skirt. PROFILE LAW: the base continues the face as a convex toe at 42-53 deg. Escarpment walls and sheet massifs are different classes, and the laws do not say which they cover.

J3 says 'no pierce; buried hidden geometry is off-language', yet the FULL SKIRT's terminal form (carried skirt laid ON the lawn, 'stock's own sheet-overlap idiom') passed visually, and the burial-pierce seat earned the first positive wall-form verdict. Overlap is lawful for LOOK, and the 4078 tag makes it lawful for WALK. That makes J3's no-pierce clause a walk constraint, not a look constraint.

THE ONE-SITE WORLD LAW appears in CLAUDE.md section 10 as 'the map holds exactly one landmass of this class'. It was measured as an occupancy enumeration for one donor size (R>=125) under the whole-block centre lattice. It says a smaller donor window or a de-deployed bench changes the answer, it dissolves on Path D (SYNTHESIS-RECONSIDERED), and no kit code enforces it.

The whole-block snap is an IDENTITY-qualification policy (so one walk stands for every site), not a look law. A 4u-shifted mint is still lawful land that passes its own gates. Read as 'prefabs may only sit on 64u blocks', it narrows placement 16x per axis on a map where the live folder has no free 3x3 window.

THE WALL-CONTEXT gate fails closed for families that were never measured (scrub, brush, dunes): absence of a census is treated as a prohibition. It also refuses everything on Path D, where SYNTHESIS-RECONSIDERED calls an off-language coast 'a decision, not a defect'.

DEFECT FOLLOWS AUTHORSHIP may be partly attention-driven: the owner inspects what changed, and stock is the reference image. The counter-evidence (carried strips drew zero complaints while prominent) is real but small. The law also runs both ways: a prefab's frozen synthetic mint is authored surface, safe only because it was walked.

The 0-of-13 gate law is applied project-wide, but the record changed once gates rendered pixels and compared against approved peers (4 caught offline; the next three verdicts passed). Read as 'gates cannot predict look', it is stronger than the evidence.

laws.statement: A per-cell tiler over arbitrary stock coast tiles cannot make continuous land: independently authored cliff faces from different places tear even when boundary verts match. laws.name: THE RING LADDER + THE LATTICE ADJACENCY LAW
laws.statement: Water bands ring land shallow to deep as sea2-sea1-sea3-sea5-sea4. Lawful pairs are only {2:1,2} {1:1,2,3,5} {3:1,3,5} {5:1,3,4,5} {4:4,5}. Sea3 never touches sea4, and the {sea1,sea5} skip of sea3 is real (20 pairs).
laws.evidence: (7,17) teardown; map-wide wang_seam_census: zero sea3-abuts-sea4 edges, all 194 shallow-to-deep transitions are sea5-mediated; s12 census finds sea1|sea4 = 0, sea2|sea4 = 0, sea2|sea5 = 0.
laws.scope_measured: All disc-1 blocks, directed tile edges, interior and cross-block.
laws.scope_applied: coastmorph._LAWFUL_ADJ (coastmorph.py:3877), the transplant wang_carry_gate (warn-only by default), and virgin_mint's ladder repair.
laws.source: coast-mosaic L20, L149, L163; transplant.py:2636-2670 (SEA_ADJ_LAWFUL); coastmorph.py:3877-3880

laws.name: RING WIDTH TRACKS BATHYMETRY
laws.statement: A coast's water ring is not a fixed-width offset. It is thick on sheltered or shelf sides and thin or absent where deep water comes close in, so a faithful coast cannot just offset a uniform band from the shore.
laws.evidence: (7,17): a full 5-6 cell ladder on the S/W shores, while on the N shore land meets sea5/sea4 almost directly. Band extents measured on (18,15): sea2 0-7u (median 2.7), sea3 8-27u (median 14).
laws.scope_measured: A teardown of one island (7,17) plus the (18,15) beach.
laws.scope_applied: Every synthetic ring. The ladder mint's 1-cell sea1 + sea5 dilation rings ignore it.

laws.name: FIRST-WATER-OFF-THE-COAST census (new this study)
laws.statement: Stock cliff/lip coasts face deep and mid water about equally, and shallows rarely. Small sea-ringed islands come in three water contexts: pure deep, a mid halo, and mixed. A minted world-island, which sits in pure sea4, matches only the deep context.
laws.evidence: Read-only scratch census (4u cells, classified by tri centroid; the shallowest sea part present in each non-land 4-neighbour). Topo-58 lip cells face sea4 2752, sea3 2169, sea5 240, sea1 59, sea2 30, beach1 24. Over 23 sea-ringed components of 20-600 cells: 6 are >=98% sea4-fronted (Uaho (0,0), (6-7,4-5), (9-10,5-7), (16-17,6-7), (20-21,9)), 7 are >=90% mid-fronted (e.g. (12,15), (17,9), (20,16), (17-18,16)), and only 7 carry any sea1/sea2/beach1.
laws.scope_measured: Disc 1, all 480 blocks, 4u cell centroid classification. Sea4 under land and partial cells make this approximate.
laws.scope_applied: Nowhere yet. world-island blanks Sea1/2/3/5 (HIDDEN_PARTS) and ships only the cut (12,0) Sea4 plane.

laws.name: CLIFF TEXTURE MAPPING + TILE-SELECTION + COLUMN QUANTIZATION + WALL V CORNER-ROLE
laws.statement: Coastal rock is one atlas strip, u[0.699,0.947], wrapped along the shore by arc length: 4 tiles, about 19.84u per wrap, one 64px tile per wall column. V is a corner assignment (crest 0.8926, base 0.9229), not a function of y. A rebuilt wall needs k equal to the old k mod 4.
laws.evidence: (7,17) teardown (sawtooth 1,1,2,2,3,3,0,0); V exact on topo-58 faces 0.9-5.5u tall on (10,18)/(9,17)/(3,13), with a small off-band minority on (7,17) (7/105) and (16,17) (4/153). In-game: the synth cliff island 'cliffs look great' after the window-translate wrap fix.
laws.scope_measured: Grass coastal topo-58 walls on 5 specimen blocks; the per-family deltas (desert/snow/canyon) were measured separately.
laws.scope_applied: Every minted wall (island.ROCK_U/ROCK_V/ROCK_DENSITY), the coast morphs, and world-river's join U continuity.
laws.source: coast-mosaic L22-23, L97, L116-118; island.py:47-50; river.py:672-680

laws.name: THE WALL-CONTEXT LAW
laws.statement: A family's wall band is keyed to its context. Stock never raises a red canyon wall (or a dunes/scrub/brush wall) from open sea, so a mint whose rim is a sea cliff refuses those grounds. Grass, desert and snow walls are measured coastal.
laws.evidence: Map-wide re-census: canyon 655 wall tris / 48 faces, 594 of them topo-49 mural; the true red wall is 60 tris / 8 faces, 0 open-sea coastal (1 below-datum gorge face). Snow 1019 tris, every face coastal. Dunes touch topo-58 zero times. The trigger was the canyon island B playtest ('I don't recall any real canyon tiles with cliffs this high').
laws.scope_measured: Wall faces by atlas band, map-wide, disc 1.
laws.scope_applied: build_landmass refuses any ground whose wall_coastal is not True (fail-closed). GroundRetile.for_donor refuses a coastal-wall donor retiled to a non-coastal family. Stock canyon DOES meet the sea, but through topo-49 murals: an unmeasured lawful path.
laws.source: studies/overworld-topography/README.md L912-944; AUDIT-AND-ROADMAP-2026-07-18.md L55-63, L199-216; island.py:431-444

laws.name: BEACHES ARE BAY ARCS, NEVER RINGS / beaches live in sheltered water
laws.statement: Every stock beach is an open arc (12-228u, median ~35-50u, gently curved, slightly concave) lining the inside of a bay, cove or lagoon. A foam ring round an islet does not exist. The rocky lip is the default coast and terminates beaches.
laws.evidence: 40 beach1 blocks, 22 ribbon segments, ZERO closed loops; renders of (13,15) and (16-17,15).
laws.scope_measured: All 480 blocks.
laws.scope_applied: The ring generator was killed. The ladder mint placed its arc by a bearing range on a convex single-lobe islet face (see the falsification).

laws.name: THE ASYMMETRIC CLASS ENVELOPE / SHAPE-CLASS LAW
laws.statement: A beach inherits the convexity class of the coast it aprons. Pockets run to -46% of chord length; true noses reach at most +19%, because sand accumulates in concavities.
laws.evidence: A 32-run re-census corrected the old +46% nose misread; the gate constants are 0.25L seaward and 0.48L landward.
laws.scope_measured: Stock beach segments.
laws.scope_applied: Beach morph gates (coastmorph). Never applied to the ladder mint's site choice.

laws.name: THE BEACH RIBBON / FOAM LANGUAGE / SAND-RIBBON LAW / BEACH TRANSLATION LAW
laws.statement: Beach1 is a one-quad animated foam swash (~4.35u, V across the ribbon, one half-tile of U per ~4u column). Sand is a single-row chain-pinned ribbon of transition tiles. No widened sand fill exists. Desert sand is the grass band's structure translated +335/1024 texels, with its own v pins.
laws.evidence: (18,15)/(17,15) anatomy; 608 foam run edges over 40 beach blocks (0.92-6.27u columns, median 4.01); 14 desert Outer-Continent beach blocks; identity round-trips byte-exact (70 foam + 34 sand cap tris).
laws.scope_measured: All beach blocks (grass and desert families).
laws.scope_applied: beach_mint, virgin_mint and GroundRetile, all in-game proven on real shores. Snow's topo-33 frozen shore is measured but not mintable.
laws.source: coast-mosaic L27, L135, L140-144, L156, L165; islandbeach.py:56-57 (FOAM_TOPO/SAND_TOPO)

laws.name: THE BEACH HINTERLAND IS A SMOOTH NEAR-FLAT PLAIN
laws.statement: Behind a stock beach the land is LOW and nearly flat: Y median 0.81-0.88 at 4u, 1.1-1.2 at 6u, ~1.5 at 8u, 2.4-2.8 at 12u, 3.2-3.9 at 16-20u. Relief starts only 12u or more inland.
laws.evidence: study_beach_profile.py, 3 regions, tight spread. The owner's ladder-mint round-3 diagnosis was 'THE HEIGHT OF THE ISLAND mixed with the slope of the beach'.
laws.scope_measured: 3 real beach regions.
laws.scope_applied: Bay-island v3 and ladder mint round 4 (--height 2.7344). Neither sank the hinterland as a profile, and bank_lower was never used inside a mint.

laws.name: THE BERM LAW + BEACHES NEVER SHARE VERTS
laws.statement: Beach berms back onto topo-0 ground only, and two beaches never share verts: they keep at least 4.06u apart (the grass-tongue separator).
laws.evidence: 664 of 702 L-chain welds map-wide; minimum separation 4.06u.
laws.scope_measured: Map-wide.
laws.scope_applied: virgin_mint and beach_mint gates.

laws.name: THE MAP IS FULL (virgin-window census) + THE CARRY REALITY
laws.statement: Only 3 virgin-beach windows exist on the whole stock map, all on the proven beach donors. (7,17) is FF9's only fully-in-block beach. The prescription is to mint on kit-built shores.
laws.evidence: Widened virgin-window sweep, filtered by topo-0 berm, sea1/sea2 fronting, no beach1 within Chebyshev-1, a run >=3 cells and a uniform dialect: winner (9,17), plus (3,13) (no sea3 room) and (7,17) (tight).
laws.scope_measured: STOCK shores at their stock positions.
laws.scope_applied: Read as 'no more beaches'. It caps DISTINCT virgin windows, not their count: every transplanted copy of a donor re-opens its windows, and island B's real-scale mint ran on a carried copy.
laws.source: coast-mosaic L55, body L2910-2937; LAW INDEX G (coast-laws.md L178)

laws.name: THE OPEN-OCEAN TARGET LAW
laws.statement: A transplant or mint target block must be true open ocean, meaning no per-block mesh assets. A mint refuses a block holding any stock part, so an island never shares a block with, or joins, stock land.
laws.evidence: Born of the (5,2)/(6,2) incident: overrides REPLACED real continent geometry ('missing meshes and random junk'). The engine half: the s34 divert fires only inside `if (block.IsSea)`. A water-only stock block loads its own prefab, which has no Terrain transform, so an island override there never renders (the (6,17) canvas incident).
laws.scope_measured: Whole-block REPLACEMENT of real land blocks, plus one water-only block.
laws.scope_applied: Every island and prefab footprint block, including the 15 stock water-only shoal blocks. My count: 30 stock 3x3 all-empty windows without x-wrap, 56 with x-wrap (prefab placement wraps x), 36/62 if water-only blocks were admissible.
laws.source: coast-mosaic L43, body L1066-1072; island.py:1411-1423, 1453; memoria-patches/s34-worldmap-mesh-override.patch L494-508; scratchpad shore/windows.py

laws.name: THE DIVERT-ARM + EFFECTIVE-PREFAB ORACLE + ABSENT-PART + PREFAB-PARTS laws
laws.statement: A cell's overrides bind only to the transforms its EFFECTIVE prefab exposes. A Terrain.ff9mesh file arms the divert to the Donor.txt prefab; without one, only the generic SeaBlockPrefab's Sea4 binds. An in-place edit cannot emit a part its cell lacks.
laws.evidence: (11,19) water-only cell: Memoria.log showed only Sea4 loaded, and Sea3/Sea5 were dead. Fixed with a degenerate Terrain stub + Donor.txt, in-game proven. The (18,3) foam-less incident. The crescent's harbor ghost-rendered from a natural donor's Object.
laws.scope_measured: s34 source (WorldMeshOverride.cs:286-289) + in-game.
laws.scope_applied: transplant.effective_prefab_arm auto-arm, the morph_in_place refusal, and the sidecar choice. It limits which water layers a minted island can ship: DEFAULT_DONOR Uaho (0,0) is itself ~98% deep-fronted, while the beach pins blocks host Sea1/2/4/5 + Beach1.

laws.name: THE SEA4-UNDER-LAND LAW (generalized: no walk-class sheet under other ground)
laws.statement: A deep-sea plane spanning beneath land makes an island boat-permeable, because the sea-level ray (y+2.34) cannot see land at 3.2 and grounds on the sea topo 57. The fix is to cut the sheet conservatively, by exact uncovered area. The same holds for any walkable sheet under carried terrain.
laws.evidence: placement.py ray ceiling; w_movementRoundCheck (ff9.cs:5682) triangle cache. The owner saw boats sail through kit islands. The bench lawn under carried terrain let Zidane walk through hills (playtest). The cove-corner hole forced area clipping (2026-10-23; 8 of 20 sweeps were holed).
laws.scope_measured: Engine source + in-game (boat; on foot on Path D).
laws.scope_applied: island._cut_plane on every land block, and the coastnav keel/belt stamp. Where land is reachable on foot, only the cut is lawful (a keel stamp arms a walk trap).

laws.name: THE SEA-LAYER LAW + THE LATTICE LAW (sea fills) + THE WINDING LAW
laws.statement: Sea sub-layers coexist by DISJOINT plan coverage, never by Y offset. A synthetic deep fill must be stock-shaped (full 4u tiles, per-cell-clipped margins, no tri spanning a tile; stock ceiling 10.5u^2 / 7u edge). Stock sea4 winds negative in plan and carries a constant tilted normal (-0.121, 0.9785, 0.1665).
laws.evidence: The (8,17) sea patch v1 z-fought (coplanar). An ear-clip fill rendered as a faceted iceberg (615u^2 tris). A wrong-wound patch drew but did not register: 73 introduced misses.
laws.scope_measured: Open water. V9: Form-1 shallow rims ramp to +0.8 under land and the Form-2 (3,9) sea4 reaches +1.527; the (7,17) waterline is a Y ramp (sea1/sea2 0 to 0.34).
laws.scope_applied: Every emitted water tile (meshedit.lattice_patch, flat_patch winding=-1).
laws.source: coast-mosaic L56; memory project-ff9-overworld-audit-roadmap.md L103-109; sea-sheet-laws L16-41

laws.name: THE FLAT-MESH INVARIANT
laws.statement: Every .ff9mesh must have vertex count equal to index count, each tri owning its own 3 verts. Orphan verts throw in RegisterBlockComponent and abort LoadBlocks for the whole world.
laws.evidence: The (8,17) sea patch v3 crashed the s34 loader in game: pale unnavigable sea far beyond the cells and a relocated spawn.
laws.scope_measured: In-game crash + every real file measures flat.
laws.scope_applied: Every writer.

laws.name: THE LEARNED WANG TABLE / DEFORMED-TILE RECT / DISCRETE ROLE-DECODE / SHADE-AGREEMENT
laws.statement: A sea1/sea5 strip tile is a pure function of which neighbours sit deeper. Its uv is a <=2u x <=2v snap-rect assigned to corner verts regardless of deformation. These two facts make shallow transition water EMITTABLE by language at a shore.
laws.evidence: 221 tiles / 10 blocks, zero contradictions. sea5 decodes 1644/1763 cells with 0 inconsistent and 0 boundary violations over 3875 edges; role decode 29/29. In game: band_convert, virgin_mint's re-band, and the {sea1,sea5} ladder corner ('the transition is clean').
laws.scope_measured: Decodable strip blocks; about a 7% inset-rect residual stays verbatim.
laws.scope_applied: strips_rebuild, band_convert, virgin_mint and the rim retile.

laws.name: THE WANG-CARRY LAW
laws.statement: A water carry must carry over, or recalculate, any Wang pattern that ran outside the pulled window. Cropping a coastal donor leaves hard shallow|deep frame seams.
laws.evidence: The (8,17)+2x2 carry: 17 frame seams, then 0 after wang_rim_retile ('good'); the shallow corner fixed by repartition.
laws.scope_measured: One carried region + a stock census showing no such edges.
laws.scope_applied: wang_carry_gate (warn by default, --enforce-wang-carry).

laws.name: THE STAMP-BORDER RULE + meadow stamps + FLAT GRASS IS NOT IN FF9's LANGUAGE
laws.statement: Rule-based Wang meadows read square, so real layout stamps are the answer, and a stamp border may carry only plain mains or strip0. A dead-flat island exposes every tile border at the game camera; real grass rolls.
laws.evidence: Meadow v1-v5 playtests; v6.2 rolling patchless island 'looks faithful'; relief resurrection 'gently rolling'.
laws.scope_measured: Grass mints.
laws.scope_applied: world-island (stamps on by default for grass, --relief opt-in).
laws.source: coast-mosaic L26, body L351-367; AUDIT L333-346

laws.name: THE CELL-CLIPPED LIP / CELL-CLIPPED FILL
laws.statement: A mains uv is its centroid cell's map clamped to that cell, so a lip or fill tri spanning two 4u cells streaks. Crest verts snap within 0.15u onto lattice lines and grass is clipped per cell.
laws.evidence: 23 streak tris in the live folder; stock lip grass never streaks (2481 tris, aspect max 5.8). Fix owner-passed from paired stills.
laws.scope_measured: Kit cliff tops; stock disc-1 lip grass.
laws.scope_applied: world-island (cell_lip default) and coastmorph fills.

laws.name: THE FREE-BASE LAW + THE CLEARANCE GATE
laws.statement: No cliff-face base edge anywhere on the map lands on walkable terrain: bases end free at or below the waterline. Cliffs are class-free; the real hazard is the outline pinching (a 4u clearance gate).
laws.evidence: Map-wide face census; 81 deg shear proven harmless in-game.
laws.scope_measured: Coastal topo-58 faces.
laws.scope_applied: Coast morphs (BASE_Y_MAX 0.75) and world-island's wall.

laws.name: THE ENGINE FOOT-WALK TABLE + MOVEMENT-CACHE SHADOW
laws.statement: Foot-legal topos are {0-7,10-13,16-23,27,28,30,31,32-38,41,42,45,46,52}; sea 53-57, lip 58, cliff 49/50 and rivers 48/51 are illegal. WMBlock.Raycast tries the actor's 10 cached tris first, so no blocked mesh may extend under walkable ground.
laws.evidence: w_moveCHRControl[0].limit {0x0010667F, 0xD8FF3CFF}; v4/v5 beach traps fixed by conforming sea.
laws.scope_measured: ff9.cs + in-game.
laws.scope_applied: Every mint and morph; topo 41 (dunes) is walkable.

laws.name: BEACHABLE-COAST (stock grammar) vs land-anywhere (kit policy)
laws.statement: Stock puts topo 53 only in front of beaches, so a cliff-ringed stock island can be sailed to but not disembarked on. The kit's default coastnav policy stamps every near-shore water tri landable (53), so a minted cliff island needs no beach to be a boat destination.
laws.evidence: R5d survey ('topo 53 fronts BEACHES ONLY'); Southern Ring land-anywhere owner-confirmed; Path D cliffs-refuse playtest-confirmed.
laws.scope_measured: Stock coast survey + 2 benches in game.
laws.scope_applied: island.landmass coastnav_policy default 'land-anywhere'.

laws.name: COASTLINE SHAPE LANGUAGE + the island SHAPE GATE
laws.statement: Stock coasts turn a median 22 deg per 8u: gentle 44% / mild 32% / corner 15% / acute 7%, sinuosity 1.21, gentle radius ~25u. The mint gate wants median turn 8-35 deg, acute <=12%, max <150 deg.
laws.evidence: 381 coastline polylines over 260 blocks.
laws.scope_measured: Terrain-footprint boundary, resampled at 8u.
laws.scope_applied: verify_landmass shape gate (island.py:1147). The early blob gave 0% acute.

laws.name: THE STRICT SHORE LAW / GROWTH CEILING
laws.statement: A RowInsert growth cut may not cross or touch sea1/sea2. Single-donor single-axis growth caps at 2 cuts / +8u.
laws.evidence: In-game cuts on (16,17) etc. The donor table is STALE: (8,16) and (7,15) now give zero ok lines, and (16,17)'s proven line trips conforming-on-line.
laws.scope_measured: 5 donors at the time.
laws.scope_applied: cut_census risk touches-shallows.

laws.name: THE HEIGHT-STEP SLIT law (why synthetic junctions tear)
laws.statement: At the game's ~15 deg pitch, a 0.5u height mismatch needs ~2u of PLAN overlap to seal. Surfaces that abut in plan at different heights (or T-junction) leave visible open faces, which top-down coverage gates cannot see.
laws.evidence: Engine-side block dumps + a cull-calibrated oblique renderer reproduced the v7 in-game tears. The donor has 42 wall tris + welded banks; v7 had zero connecting faces.
laws.scope_measured: Synth bay island (4,2) vs donor (18,15).
laws.scope_applied: tear_sweep builder gate in the bay_warp scratch line. Not a kit gate for world-island or the ladder mint.

laws.name: THE JOIN COLUMN (a minted wall meets a stock lip bit for bit)
laws.statement: A kit-minted cliff can knit to a carried stock coast fragment at a lip column. The column's crest and base are pinned to the stock floats (rim_at), and the rock band's U is made continuous through shore_origin plus an arc length congruent to the 19.84u band period. The lip and the kit wall are one language (slope 70.9-72.8 vs 72.7 deg, same V rows, same U density).
laws.evidence: world-river rung 4, owner-passed in game: 'walking the cliff top across both joins never drops', the Blue Narciss sails the cove to the beach, 'the bay passes'.
laws.scope_measured: One fragment (cluster C, (16,14)-(17,15): river + beached cove + both beaches), rotation 0, whole-block offset.
laws.scope_applied: The world-river verb only (--donor cluster-c).

laws.name: THE DUNES SIZE-CLASS LAW
laws.statement: Stock has exactly two dunes components (273 / 130 cells) and zero smaller blobs or freckles. A lawful dunes field needs a footprint of about 130 cells or more, so no small dunes prefab exists.
laws.evidence: dunes_blob_shapes.py census (solid). The MECHANISM claim ('the dressing is why'; even a transplant of comp[0]'s real boundary arrangement quilts on a ~31-cell blob) came from a 4-rung offline calibrated-eye ladder with zero playtests, every variant a label stamp at zero vertex motion and ori 0.
laws.scope_measured: The census: map-wide. The mechanism: one 31-cell lobe on an ~80-cell host, label-stamp pipeline only.
laws.scope_applied: PREFABS.md ('no small dunes prefab'); wall_coastal=False keeps dunes off coasts.

laws.name: THE LABEL-STAMP FALLACY / 'real content through a synthetic frame is still synthesis'
laws.statement: A verbatim stamp must carry the MESH (verts, per-corner UVs, tangents), not row labels through a synthetic frame.
laws.evidence: Real-scale whole-stamp rejected in game as castellated: 100% of seam verts on the grid vs stock's 14.6% off-grid; ori-0 only; per-corner UVs donor-derived for 2.1% of cells. The true mesh carry passed ('the ecotone is nice now').
laws.scope_measured: The dunes|desert ecotone at 130-143 cells.
laws.scope_applied: All carries; also the bend-carry and ribbon-warp verdicts.

laws.name: THE FORM LESSON
laws.statement: Statistics reproduce a co-authored surface's measured properties, never its look. Each round fixes the named defect and mints a new one.
laws.evidence: massif_synth 8 rounds; the ladder mint 4; the terrace bend-carry 3; the bay-island rule synth 3 + ribbon-warp ~9.
laws.scope_measured: Co-authored surfaces: rock massif organization, the beach band, the coastal escarpment, the dune ecotone. NOT free tilings: grass mains, the sea quadrants, the rock lip strip, the learned Wang strips are all in-game proven synthesizable.
laws.scope_applied: Read as 'never synthesize': PREFABS.md frames synth as arrangement search only.
laws.source: interior-topography memory L541-545; README.md L252-256, L842-845; PREFABS.md L12-17

laws.name: COMPONENTS ARE GEOMETRY+TEXTURE+TOPO UNITS + THE PAINTED-WASH COMPONENT LAW + PATCH-AVOIDANCE
laws.statement: Texture substitution across component classes fails. No per-cell fill can continue a painted wash. Patch families (topo 4/38/42) are inviolable: a drop touching one refuses.
laws.evidence: TWEAK 2 v6 (rock on a sand ramp); 4 wash fill policies falsified in game; the crescent's whole-consumption refused by the owner.
laws.scope_measured: Carried real coasts under edit.
laws.scope_applied: coastmorph fill lanes, cut_census crosses-wash, _patch_guard.

laws.name: THE PREFAB FRAME / whole-block shift identity
laws.statement: A framed mint plus carries placed at a whole-64u-block offset writes identical triangles. Any sub-block shift re-clips cells and gives different land.
laws.evidence: Measured: 4u/32u differ, 64/128/192u identical; relief noise, the decal shuffle and the apron hash made relative; float32 triangle multiset fingerprint; desert-peak-isle owner-walked at (10,9).
laws.scope_measured: Grass/desert/snow mints, forest, hill and mountain carries. Transplant units are UNMEASURED under shift.
laws.scope_applied: world-prefab placement. --prefab-frame refuses --beach and a custom outline.

tensions: COPY-ONLY vs EMITTED SHALLOWS: the LAW INDEX (coast-mosaic L19) and sea-sheet-laws L65 still say shallow water is 'copy-only'. Yet the kit emits sea1/sea2 by language at shores, in-game proven: virgin_mint's wash re-band, band_convert, the sea1 ladder corner, strips_rebuild; and the ladder mint's ring/zip water was itself judged 'sound'. Only the SHORE-BOUND half is supported. 'Copy-only' is over-restrictive and steers prefab thinking away from a synthesized water ring.

TWO LAWFUL-ADJACENCY TABLES DISAGREE on sea2|sea3. transplant.SEA_ADJ_LAWFUL admits it (9 stock instances, 'sea2's DEEPEST lawful neighbour', transplant.py:2655). coastmorph._LAWFUL_ADJ omits it (coastmorph.py:3877-3880), the LAW INDEX says {2:1,2}, and virgin_mint's docstring treats '{2,3} is off-language' as a trigger for a re-band. One of them is wrong, or the 9 are a regional dialect; a re-census decides.

LAND NEVER KNITS vs THE JOIN COLUMN: the FUSE LAW was measured on cross-location cliff FACES (Test C, 2 pairs) and is applied as 'an island never joins stock land' (island.py:1453). world-river joins a minted wall to a stock lip bit for bit and is owner-passed. The real law is narrower: two independently authored faces tear, while a lip column in the same rock language knits when the crest/base floats are pinned and U stays continuous.

THE BEACH RECORD SPLITS BY HOST, NOT BY SYNTHESIS: about 16 rounds of beach synthesis on SYNTHETIC hosts failed (bay rule synth 3, ribbon-warp ~6 deployed, ladder mint 4). Beach MINTS on REAL hosts passed first deploy (beach_mint 1/2a, virgin_mint 3, island B's beach). Every failure died at a JUNCTION authored against synthetic flanks (pinch ends, transition walls, taper over kept sea4). Every success pinned its ends to real crease/cap/convergence verts. That sharpens THE DEFECT FOLLOWS THE AUTHORSHIP: the authored JUNCTION is where defects land, not the authored beach.

THE LADDER MINT WAS SITED OFF-LANGUAGE BY ITS OWN PLANNER: the beach grammar says beaches line concave sheltered bays with a low hinterland. plan_arc (islandbeach.py:59-90) only accepts a contiguous bearing arc and refuses concave crossings, and the mint was a single-lobe r18 islet at height 3.2 then 2.7344 in pure deep water. The 4-round falsification therefore cannot separate 'a beach cannot be minted' from 'a beach was minted on the wrong coast class'.

THE OPEN-OCEAN TARGET LAW: MEASURED ON REPLACEMENT, APPLIED TO ADJACENCY. It was born from overrides that REPLACED whole real blocks ((5,2)/(6,2)). Its engine half is real only for water-only stock blocks: the s34 divert is inside `if (block.IsSea)`, so a stock prefab without a Terrain transform cannot host a minted island. A stock LAND block has a Terrain transform and is edited in place routinely (morph_in_place, virgin_mint, world-terrain). Composing a minted island INTO a stock coastal block as an in-place edit is therefore refused by kit scope, not by the engine.

My read-only count gives 56 windows with x-wrap (2x2: 92 vs 110; 4x4: 4 vs 19). Admitting the 15 water-only shoal blocks would add 6 non-wrap 3x3 windows. THE ONE-SITE WORLD LAW is a room statement that inherits this count.

tensions: NORMALS ARE RENDER-INERT (engine fact, consumption C2 + GROUND-JUNCTION-SYNTHESIS S3) vs a body of laws and fixes premised on normals: WALL MESH ORGANIZATION law 3 ('our synth used (0,1,0) everywhere -- flat washed lighting', interior-topography:285-287), the Uaho v3.2 'STALE NORMALS' tonal-ring fix (:653-659), the terrace-wall lesson 'flatness + uniform normals amplifies the mains anisotropy' (TERRACE-WALL-PREDICTION round 2 item 2), grassland.smooth_normals' docstring 'the engine lights with them and the dapple masks tile borders' (grassland.py:683-685), and the hill's 'LOCAL normal re-smoothing' listed as part of the grass-hill LANGUAGE (interior.py:28-30; cli world-hill help). The v3.2 round changed normals AND reverted the clamp streaks in one bundle, so its success cannot be credited to normals; the clamp revert is the only change that could alter pixels. Normal-handling should be dropped from 'the language' and from any synthesis cost model.

THE TERRACE-WALL DISCRIMINANT REFUTATION IS CONFOUNDED BY ITS OWN PREMISE: the 2026-07-30 test built a wall 'expressible as an exact-linear tile language' from rock_wall_language.py. The 2026-10 uvclass lane (R3) found that reference wall is only 29.6% genuinely one-tile-per-quad, with 92% of its tris in continuous charts spanning >=4 tiles (a Uaho-style band sweep). The decode's grouping guard cut charts at tile lines by construction. So the test did not actually probe a tile-language target, and 'massing is the carrier' was inferred from a texture model that was itself mostly wrong.

NEVER-FLAT stock grass (0 dead-flat cells, std 0.46-1.11) vs flat-by-design minted interiors repeatedly approved in game (island E; the r52 desert 'fine desert'; owner chose RETIRE over fix for relief), vs 'a dead-flat shelf bands even under lawful mains' (terrace wall round 2). Whether flatness reads seems to depend on context (lowland at the world camera vs an elevated shelf) or on the confounded normals claim. Nobody has registered a test that isolates it.

RELIEF vs THE HILL STACKING GUARD: relief was resurrected (in-game proven), but world-hill still refuses any footprint whose y-span exceeds 2.4u, a guard designed when every mint was flat. My read-only sampling of the shipped grassland.relief (amp 1.3, 40 random sites, r20 disc) gave y-span p50 1.96 / p90 2.68 / max 2.89; 22.5% of footprints exceed 2.4, and desert (x1.6) is worse. The guard cannot tell ambient relief from a prior hill. The CLI then declares relief 'mutually exclusive' with all three relief verbs, although stock hills/forests/massifs sit ON regional ground fields (S5: a calm host is only ~10% of stock components). The policy forces off-language flat hosts for every carried feature.

ROCK-RIGID 0.035 vs measured tolerance: uvclass predicted x1.25 canopy 'shows' and rock x2.0 at 63.5% inside, and both were refuted PERMISSIVELY in game (x2.0 rock and x1.5 canopy pass). The rigid law's own origin, the blend-conform smear, was a LOCAL non-uniform deformation. The operative boundary looks like smooth/global vs local/high-frequency, not magnitude. The kit encodes magnitude ceilings (0.035 drift, x1.5, x2.0) measured on ONE donor each (Uaho, (15,15)) and applies them to all donors.

CLAUDE.md sec 8 'real content through a synthetic frame is still synthesis' vs the record: a RIGID carry inside a minted frame (Rung F, Uaho apron/zip, prefabs) is the proven road. The line was minted from a WARPED carry (the bend-carry's per-vert ribbon corrections) and the label-stamp, and as written it forbids the one hybrid that works (SYNTHESIS-RECONSIDERED 'A sec 8 line that mis-summarizes').

DUNES SIZE-CLASS LAW vs THE LABEL-STAMP FALLACY: the size class was concluded from label-stamped 31-cell blobs. The decisive 'transplant control' laid stock's ARRANGEMENT (labels) on kit lattice geometry, which is the very mechanism later shown, at 130 cells, to cause castellation (0% off-grid seam verts vs stock 14.6%, all ori-0). A true mesh carry below 130 cells was never tested, so 'no small dunes prefab' (PREFABS.md) rests on a confounded experiment. The geometric half (61% boundary vs 32-45%) is independent and may still hold.

THE ONE-SITE WORLD LAW is named a law but is an occupancy census of the 2026-07-25 stock+deployed map. After the 2026-11 world reset all 30 stock open-ocean 3x3 windows are free (PREFABS P2), and on Path D/9013 it dissolves entirely (SYNTHESIS-RECONSIDERED). Yet prefabs bake it in as max_per_world = 1.

COASTLINE SHAPE GATE vs GENERATOR: the gate (fixed 8u step, med_turn >= 8 deg) correctly encodes a scale-invariant stock fact (coasts turn ~22 deg per 8u at every size). blob_outline's undulation is low-frequency (f=2..5, amplitude ~1/f), so its 8u turning falls as 1/R and a single mass over ~r80 cannot pass. The constraint lands on large single-mass islands, the owner's 'new landmass' case, and comes from the generator, not from FF9.

THE TRANSLATION LAW IS UNIVERSAL vs the grass-only hill: build_hill accepts only fam=='main' tris (grass mains u-range; interior.py:1384, :1426), and soup_from_blocks labels every non-zero topo 'topoN'. Desert/snow hills are refused even though the same pure-Y-on-XZ-linear-mains argument proves tile lawfulness for any translated family. F13 records this but it was never executed. The real gap is an unmeasured desert/snow hill LANGUAGE (desert relief is 1.5-2x rougher), not a tile risk.

Two different 'lawful slope' ceilings: the hill gate uses MAX_FLANK 28.6 (the lowland-grass topo p99). uvclass's L.rule plan-law envelope is p99 35.0 deg (0.47% steeper than 40). GROUND-JUNCTION S1 puts the per-cell UV vocabulary break at 40 deg. Each was measured over a different population (topo class vs UV chart class vs cell budget), and the kit picks the most conservative without saying why.

THE CANOPY CARRY LAW's stated reason (non-affine 28-35 patches, 'NO tile language') was corrected by UV-09/R1: canopy is tile-scale charts (<=2x2) of SHARED art, the L.free class. The outcome (carry) stands on the in-game record, but the reason that ruled out chart-level synthesis is gone, and the two falsified synth attempts both used per-TRI picks.

Rock 'murals' (the BAKED-TERRAIN law, transplant.py's 97%-unique metric) are shared art (p50 far-reuse 31 blocks; the metric flags 43% of plain grass as 'unique' and fails its negative control). The refusal stands for a different reason: non-affine, unkeyed flow. So rock is SHARED material arranged by hand, which is exactly the regime where carrying the arrangement and re-placing it (prefab, spread, rot) works while generating it fails.

Meadow/vocabulary density vs landmass scale: place_stamps defaults to n_patches=2 per island whatever its size, while stock plains carry ~15-20% secondary tile-set area. The desert mint is 100% mains vs stock's ~32%. Both read fine at bench scale (r52), but prefabs aim at bigger, reusable landmasses, where the gap grows with area. It is earmarked, not measured.

laws.name: THE GROUND QUERY IS A FIRST-HIT DOWN RAY WITH A CLIMB CEILING ONLY
laws.statement: A walking step casts down from y+2.34375 with unlimited reach (ff9.rayDistance 2.8 is passed in but never read), so any drop is legal and the only limit is a climb above 2.34375u per ~0.4375u step (a one-way wall past ~79.4 deg on lawn). Spawn, arrival and teleport cast from y+400.
laws.evidence: Source RE of ff9.cs w_nwpHit, WMBlock.Raycast, WMPhysics.Raycast; reproduced byte-exact by the offline simulator, which matched the in-game blob stranding and Uaho grounding.
laws.scope_measured: Memoria source (stock code) plus in-game controls (blob, Uaho, grass island)
laws.scope_applied: Every world writer: terrain._walk_gate, the island census, MOAT and VERGE gates, the hill and relief envelopes

laws.name: THE CANOPY SINK caps the climb from 36/37/38 at 1.171875
laws.statement: On topographs 36, 37 and 38 the party (and chocobos) sink 1.171875, so the step ceiling FROM canopy or hillside is 1.17u, not 2.34u. Water topographs have their own walk sinks too (53 0.195, 54 0.586, 56/57 1.367).
laws.evidence: ff9.cs:19 and :5636-5667 (w_movementSinkArray). In-game: a forest control missed by exactly 1.171875 (RESULTS section 2, round 5); the chocobo forest sink was -1.1732.
laws.scope_measured: Source plus harness heights on stock forest and lab cells
laws.scope_applied: terrain._climb_barrier (reach 1.171875 on 36-38); any synth canopy or brush
laws.source: studies/terrain-malleability/vertical/NOTES.md Contradictions 2; ingame/RESULTS.md section 2 and Instrument lessons

laws.name: EVERY MISS IS GROUND 0 (THE STRANDING FALLBACK + THE VEHICLE WALL)
laws.statement: A null or not-ready block, or a ray that hits nothing, returns defaultHeight 0. On land that strands the player under the surface. On water it is a void render and an invisible wall that blocks vehicles.
laws.evidence: Source; in game the airship bounced off the one missing (12,0) sea4 quad at (252,-111). mesh.fill_missing_grid_quads was added after that.
laws.scope_measured: Source plus one in-game airship incident
laws.scope_applied: Island census gate MISS==0 anywhere in a cell (land and water)
laws.source: placement-rules memory rule 2 and the VEHICLE WALL paragraph; world/placement.py census docstring :362-385

laws.name: FIRST MESH, THEN FIRST TRIANGLE IN BUFFER ORDER, WINS
laws.statement: A block's form-1 walk meshes are scanned in registration order (Object, Terrain, Beach1/2, Stream, River, RiverJoint, Falls, Sea1-6). Inside a mesh the FIRST passing triangle in index order wins, not the nearest one. So stacked walkable sheets resolve by buffer position, and a submerged up-facing Terrain tri shadows the sea above it. There are two hard-coded exceptions: block 219 (Water Shrine) and the volcano splice.
laws.evidence: WMWorld.cs LoadBlock :588-807, WMBlock.cs:185-200; consumption lane registration list; the walk-query decode was double-adversarially verified.
laws.scope_measured: Source; the 254/254 log-calibrated bind oracle
laws.scope_applied: placement.REGISTRATION_ORDER and check_order_exceptions; the stacked-sheet census; THE CAMERA ORDER (emit feature tris before the ground sheet)
laws.source: world/placement.py:78-90; consumption/NOTES.md section 4; placement-rules memory rules 3-4 and the 2026-08-01 camera note

laws.name: UP-FACING IS THE GEOMETRIC WINDING NORMAL (ny > 0.1)
laws.statement: The walk filter normalises Cross(v1-v0, v2-v0) and needs ny > 0.1. Stored normals are ignored. A down-wound top is invisible to walking and is back-face culled.
laws.evidence: WMBlock.cs:70, WMPhysics.cs:22. The synth blob's whole top was wound ny=-0.99, which caused the triple in-game stranding, reproduced offline.
laws.scope_measured: Source plus the blob post-mortem
laws.scope_applied: Winding enforced at emit in island/mesh; the down-facing gate (with MTN_STOCK_DOWN_NY -0.02 for verbatim donor tris)
laws.source: placement-rules memory rule 5; terrain-authoring memory bug 2; terrain-malleability memory round 22

laws.name: THE MOVEMENT-CACHE SHADOW (rule f): no blocked mesh may extend under walkable ground
laws.statement: The walker's 10-slot ring of recently hit tris is retested FIRST, with no filter (no mapid skip and no up-facing test), and is never invalidated. A sea or blocked tri lying under walkable ground can be re-hit from the cache and trap the player.
laws.evidence: WMBlock.cs:145-179, ff9.cs:10749-10760; in game the bay island 'sometimes trapped on the beach' and island F was stuck at (200,-1125). WALK-QUERY-DECODE confirms the retest is filter-free.
laws.scope_measured: Source plus 2 in-game traps on kit islands
laws.scope_applied: Superseded MOAT gate; the current VERGE RULE (walkable synth within 2u of the outline emits blocked topo 49)

laws.name: THE BLOCK LAW: only the block containing the query point answers
laws.statement: There is no spatial index and no cross-block query. Geometry outside a block's 64x64 footprint is render-only, so every synth triangle must be CLIPPED at 64u block borders and partitioned per block.
laws.evidence: Source (capacity X8); island.py emits a world-frame soup clipped at block borders with shared cut points.
laws.scope_measured: Source
laws.scope_applied: island.build_landmass clipping; the reason prefabs snap to whole blocks (a sub-block shift re-clips)

laws.name: THE UNINDEXED CONTRACT + THE 65535 CEILING
laws.statement: Every .ff9mesh must have vcount == icount (3 fresh verts per tri). A surplus vertex makes LoadBlocks throw and the block dies; a deficit builds TriangleNormals short. The loader admits 1..65535 verts, which is 21,845 tris per part. The 'Unity 65000' cap is REFUTED in game.
laws.evidence: WMBlock.cs:60-73; WorldMeshOverride.cs ReadMesh (vcount <= 65535, icount <= 3*vcount); a 12-vert surplus killed a block in game (V-corner deploy); 65,001- and 65,535-vert parts render and walk (RESULTS section 8).
laws.scope_measured: Source plus in-game deploys
laws.scope_applied: write_ff9mesh asserts it; mesh.MAX_MESH_VERTS = 65535

laws.name: QUERY COST IS LINEAR IN TRIS (budget ~5k tris per walkable part)
laws.statement: Every probe that misses the cache runs a full O(N) scan of the block's walk tris. Refinement x4 or x16 is free in normal play; x64 (21.6k tris) halves the walking frame rate (about 41 to 21 fps). The whole map is resident (no LOD, no streaming), so memory is a whole-map budget.
laws.evidence: capacity X4/X8 (source plus walk_cost_sim); in-game cost session (RESULTS section 13).
laws.scope_measured: One refined walkable cell in game; simulation on 3 blocks
laws.scope_applied: Advisory budget only (no gate found); bounds any high-resolution synthesis
laws.source: terrain-malleability memory COST line; capacity/NOTES.md E8, E9, X8, X10

laws.name: WorldMap/Terrain renders from position + uv0 ONLY
laws.statement: Terrain, Object, Sea, Beach, River and Volcano parts use a shader that binds vertex + texcoord only, with uniform lighting. Normals, tangents and colour do not change pixels (Falls and Stream excepted). Every texture law is a LOOK law, and a UV change never changes gameplay.
laws.evidence: Shader census plus WMBlock.cs:106-110; WMMesh.Normals has zero non-debug readers; round 8's normal pass changed no pixel.
laws.scope_measured: Bundle and install shader copies; source grep
laws.scope_applied: GROUND-JUNCTION verdict 'add no normal gate'; the prefab fingerprint rounds normals because they are not read
laws.source: consumption/NOTES.md section 2; GROUND-JUNCTION-SYNTHESIS.md 'THREE BELIEFS'; uvclass/NOTES.md Engine evidence

Movement legality is a per-vehicle 64-bit topograph mask (on foot 0x0010667F/0xD8FF3CFF: 49/58/59 blocked; boat admits 53/54/57). IDALL 4078/4088/2040 are skipped by the ground query (the render-only class, e.g. stream banks), and 0x31EE vetoes.

laws.name: THE EFFECTIVE-PREFAB LAW (a cell's part schema is its host prefab's)
laws.statement: An override binds only if the cell's effective prefab has that child name. IsSea=0 uses the cell's own prefab.
