tensions: CLAUDE.md section 8 says 'real content through a synthetic frame is still synthesis', but the record has two passing frames: Rung F (rigid core in a minted frame) and the July ribbon-WARP of a real beach (a warp, in-game proven). What the record supports is narrower: deformation beyond the uv-class envelope (uvclass LAWFUL DEFORMATIONS), applied to a thick 3D body (the v3 cliff), fails; a thin coast-hugging warp or a rigid carry passes. SYNTHESIS-RECONSIDERED already flags the section 8 line as a mis-summary, but the line is still in the brief.

The tile-language discriminant was refuted by the terrace wall, yet the purest tile-language synthesis (ocean marching band) passes. What separates them is MASSING. Water, flat mains, pure-Y hills, smooth relief and a single-profile cliff (measured equal to stock's 72.7 deg wall) all have low-dimensional or no 3D massing to invent. Massif flanks and terrace walls do. The record is consistent with 'synthesis passes where stock's own massing is low-dimensional', but that is again ex-post (n~10) and needs a registered prediction.

THE OPEN-OCEAN TARGET LAW's comment calls itself a proxy for IsSea, and its 'no Terrain transform' rationale is engine-true only for the 15 water-only non-IsSea blocks per disc. Coastal and land blocks have a Terrain child that binds (consumption section 4). It also probes STOCK assets, so a block whose stock land was SUNK (world-sink) or reset still refuses. The engine-true test would be the effective-prefab bind oracle plus live occupancy. The tension: the same law is what buys 'one walk stands for every site' (context identity), so relaxing it requires the fingerprint to cover the bound part set, not only the files.

Edged-z is declared kit policy (mesh.py:65; C15), justified by EXISTING land never meeting across the row edge. That is irrelevant for NEW placement. Measured here: allowing z-wrap raises open 3x3 windows from 56 to 71 and 4x4 from 19 to 32 (x-wrapped). The originating incident (dunes rows 20-22) was an off-grid write that label wrapping would also prevent. The z seam is engine-lawful but has never been walked in game; the x seam has (world-river at 512,128).

PREFABS.md says 'the stock map has 30 open 3x3 windows'. That is the count with NEITHER axis wrapped, while prefab.py already wraps columns (wrap_block_col). With x-wrap the stock count is 56 (4x4: 19 vs 4). The doc understates room by the kit's own x-seam support.

The prefab fingerprint (triangle multiset) is stricter than what the engine draws or walks. A 0-mod-4 shift keeps every mains tile on the lattice (uvclass: 'L.rule 0-mod-4 exact') and only re-clips at block borders, splitting triangles along a line without changing the piecewise-linear surface. 'Different land' at a 4u shift was measured as different TRIANGLES, not a different rendered or walked surface. The block-local hazards that could make it really different (the Sea4 plane hole quad, block-cut lines as lattice-edge traps, the footprint touching an extra block, the per-block relief frame) are listed but not measured.

'MISS must be 0 everywhere in the cell' (placement-rules) vs THE NO-INTRODUCED-MISSES CENSUS LAW (real donors miss in situ). The stock area atlas also reports 822 MISS samples per disc (591 in blocks 16-17,14-15), while capacity's scan_cost reports a plan miss rate of 0 over 260 blocks x 256 points. Two stock censuses disagree on whether stock is miss-free; the absolute-0 gate on synth is policy.

THE ONE-SITE WORLD LAW and THE DUNES SIZE-CLASS / COMPOSITION FOOTPRINT laws are occupancy/footprint budgets, not look laws. They are applied as if permanent, but the owner's 2026-11 world reset freed all stock windows, and on a blank Path D world (s75 BLANK, 480 IsSea) they dissolve. The prefab frame under --target-disc is unmeasured.

THE WALL-CONTEXT LAW fails CLOSED on unmeasured families (scrub/brush/dunes). That treats 'unmeasured' as 'refuted', though it is a painted-grammar statement with zero mesh consequence (SYNTHESIS-RECONSIDERED point 3).

MAX_FLANK 28.6 deg (stock lowland p99, a look heuristic) vs the uv-class L.rule envelope of ~35 deg vs the engine's ~79 deg walk limit on lawn (69.5 deg on canopy). Three different 'slope laws' bound relief, and only the 2.34375/1.171875 climb is an engine fact.

THE SHAPE GATE's med_turn >= 8 deg/8u refuses one-lobe islands over ~r80. That is the blob generator's ripple failing to scale, caught by a stock marginal, not a stock law forbidding large round islands. The fix lives in the generator (scale ripple and dents with radius), not in more lobes per se.

Prefabs answer 'gates are not oracles' by qualifying bytes with one walk. But 'one walk stands for every site' assumes the experience is position-invariant. That holds for render (uniform lighting, no LOD, camera reads only geometry) and for area-derived channels (area 14 everywhere: place 0, no weather, safe zone under s60). It is NOT proven for the disc-4 mirror if disc 4's neighbourhood differs, for the mist/fog bit that keys encounters, or for the chart redraw.

THE DEFECT FOLLOWS THE AUTHORSHIP and the 0-of-13 gate figure were measured on ONE arc (the Path-D mesa ring) but are applied project-wide in CLAUDE.md section 7. They are probably right in spirit, but the scope was never re-measured on, e.g., the terrain-malleability rounds, where registered predictions passed 10/10 to 77/77 in game.

laws.name: THE BLOCK LAW (one block answers the ground query)
laws.statement: The engine raycasts only the walk tris of the block that holds the query point, so every landmass triangle is clipped at the 64u block borders and partitioned per block. A tri that crosses a border is a collision hole.
laws.evidence: WMPhysics.cs:13-46 / WMBlock.cs:137-200 (capacity NOTES X8); island.py module docstring 'Multi-cell by construction' (~lines 18-24)
laws.scope_measured: Stock engine source, all 480 blocks
laws.scope_applied: Every mint, carry and prefab. It is also why a prefab shift that is not a whole block re-clips the land.

laws.name: THE WHOLE-BLOCK PREFAB SHIFT LAW
laws.statement: A prefab writes the same triangles only when it is moved by whole 64u blocks. Shifts of 4u and 32u re-clip the block and cell borders and give different land. Shifts of 64, 128 and 192u are identical in position and UV.
laws.evidence: Offline measurement table, PREFABS.md:25-34 (prefab_xlate_probe.py, prefab_folder_compare.py, prefab_mesh_diff.py)
laws.scope_measured: build_landmass grass/desert/snow with 1-2 lobes, the r44/r60 islands, desert-peak and forest-blob carries, two sites 128u apart: (0-2,13-15) vs (0-2,15-17)
laws.scope_applied: Every prefab placement: world-prefab --cell snaps to blocks. This is a rule for IDENTITY, not for lawfulness: a 4u-shifted mint is a new, unqualified candidate, not an unlawful one.

laws.name: THE PREFAB FRAME (three position leaks, opt-in)
laws.statement: Three draws in a mint read ABSOLUTE position: the meadow-decal shuffle (set order), the rolling-relief noise and its centre-derived seed, and the mountain apron's fallback-tile hash (0xF95). The frame reads them relative to the corner of the anchor block. It is opt-in, so every recipe already on disk keeps replaying its own bytes. The frame refuses a missing --seed, --beach and custom outlines.
laws.evidence: Default-off unchanged across 14 mint configs. Framed runs byte-identical at sites 128u apart. Five mutations each turn tests/test_world_prefab_frame.py red.
laws.scope_measured: world-island (meadow + relief), world-mountain desert peak, forest and hill (the forest and hill need no flag)
laws.scope_applied: FRAMED_TABLES = island, mountain; PREFAB_TABLES = island, mountain, forest, hill only

laws.name: THE FINGERPRINT HASHES TRIANGLES, NOT FILES (float32 comparator)
laws.statement: A prefab's identity is a sha256 over triangles taken at float32 precision. Each triangle is its position, uv and tangent, plus the normal rounded to 1e-6, rotated to start at its smallest corner so the winding is kept. File bytes differ in vertex order, and float64 shows 1e-15 UV noise that is not different land.
laws.evidence: P1 measurement: the framed mint writes the same triangles at every site but not in the same vertex order. Comparator law: a float64 compare reads as different land when it is not.
laws.scope_measured: Two catalog prefabs at (1,14), (1,16), (21,1) and (2,17); the live placement at (10,9)
laws.scope_applied: Every world-prefab placement, staged and written. NOTE: the fingerprint covers disc 1 only (prefab._block_files disc=1), while place() also mirrors to disc 4.

laws.name: THE CLEAR WINDOW
laws.statement: A prefab places only where the target folder holds no override in its footprint or in any relief row's read window (centre +/- reach, default 96u; the hill uses max(96, r+10)), and no other FolderNames folder holds one in the footprint. The staged bytes then stand for the target's.
laws.evidence: prefab.window_blockers / read_windows. A second placement on the same block refuses (24 tests in tests/test_world_prefab.py).
laws.scope_measured: Offline staging plus the live (10,9) placement
laws.scope_applied: Every world-prefab. It also refuses a prefab next to other kit land within 96u of a relief centre, even off the footprint.

laws.name: THE OPEN-OCEAN TARGET LAW (a proxy that reads the stock bundle, not the live map)
laws.statement: Every footprint block of a mint, carry or prefab must have NO stock per-block mesh assets, that is be a true open-ocean IsSea cell rendered from SeaBlockPrefab. Rationale 1: a water-only own-prefab block has no Terrain transform, so the override is dead. Rationale 2: a land block would have real continent geometry replaced.

The real limits are gates: flank <= MAX_FLANK 28.6 deg (stock lowland p99), peak <= PEAK_CAP 8.6 (the lowland band top), a footprint of pure mains with relief span <= 2.4u, and clearances from forest (12u), stamps (4u) and rock (6u).
laws.evidence: handles.py comment at line 159. interior constants are measured from stock (hill_at_scale.py). C6 in game: 3.199 -> 7.320 (predicted 7.322).
laws.scope_measured: Stock lowland grass slopes and band; C6 bench
laws.scope_applied: Every hill. No verb raises ground into the 26-32u highland world.

laws.name: THE TERRACE LAW
laws.statement: Stock interior ground lives in two walkable altitude worlds, 2-8u and 26-32u, with rock in between. Hills are capped to the lowland band, and island --height defaults to 3.2 (the coastal-cliff interior median).
laws.evidence: 2026-07-12 census of all 260 disc-1 blocks
laws.scope_measured: Disc 1 interior
laws.scope_applied: PEAK_CAP 8.6 for hills. No highland or plateau mint verb exists, and the 20 topo-36 plateau forests are untested for want of a plateau host.

laws.name: Engine step / climb ceilings
laws.statement: Foot step ~0.44/frame; engine single-step rise 2.34375u; one-way wall per tick 2.34375/0.4375u ~ 79.4 deg refuse (28.6 deg warns). The canopy sinks 1.171875 on topo 36-38. The foot mask refuses topo 49 (rock).
laws.evidence: MTN_ZIP_RISE 2.34, MAX_RISE 2.25, GATE_CLIMB 2.30; THE ONE-WAY WALL GATE (3D review rec 9); w_movementCheckTopographID mask 0x0010667F/0xD8FF3CFF
laws.scope_measured: Engine source plus harness walks
laws.scope_applied: Every zip, apron and canopy rim any carry or mint emits

laws.name: THE ROCK-RIGID GATE (deformation must be DECLARED)
laws.statement: Carried rock edge lengths may drift at most 0.035 from the DECLARED shape: the donor itself, or its --rock-height / --spread map. Undeclared per-vertex pulls refuse.
laws.evidence: X1: 'the v1/v2 blend conform's smear stays refuted (an uneven, rim-driven per-vertex pull, not a height scale)'
laws.scope_measured: Uaho blend-conform rounds vs X1 pure-Y scale
laws.scope_applied: Every world-mountain carve. In practice it separates passing smooth, global, declared transforms (rotation, uniform spread, pure-Y scale, de-tilt shear) from failing per-vertex warps.

laws.name: THE FORM LESSON (current refined form)
laws.statement: Statistics reproduce a rock organization's measured properties, never its look. Refined twice: (1) the failures were all texture organization on invented ROCK massing, never low-relief ground geometry; (2) even a faithfully decoded tile language fails on invented MASSING. The silhouette (plan jogs, ledge shelves, foot talus) carries the look.
laws.evidence: Massif synth 8 rounds, bend-carry 3, ladder mint 4, terrace wall 2. SYNTHESIS-RECONSIDERED sorts passing synthesis as geometry and tile language; the terrace wall refuted that discriminant.
laws.scope_measured: Small Uaho-scale massif on a ~r26-31 grass islet; a beach on an r18 desert islet; the terrace wall on one Disc9 bench
laws.scope_applied: CLAUDE.md section 8 and the editor's design call ('arrange carried shapes, never sculpt'): no brush, no from-scratch surface

laws.name: THE DEFECT FOLLOWS THE AUTHORSHIP
laws.statement: 12 of 13 playtest verdicts and 32 of 37 named defects landed on whatever the round had most recently authored; none landed on carried stock geometry in its own context.
laws.evidence: The Path-D wall arc tally (20-agent study, 2026-07-31). Rung F's 7 playtests repeat it: carried core 0/1454 defective, fill 2305 tris defective.
laws.scope_measured: One arc (a Path-D carried wall on a flat host) plus Rung F
laws.scope_applied: The editor's design call and the prefab rationale: 'a prefab mints no new surface after the walk that qualified it'

laws.name: A GREEN GATE SUITE IS A REGRESSION HARNESS, NOT AN ORACLE
laws.statement: 0 of 13 verdicts were predicted by a gate. Every gate scores an element against stock's marginals, and none asks whether stock ever builds that SHAPE. So a candidate prefab is qualified only by an in-game walk.
laws.evidence: Path-D wall arc. Rungs C/D/E were 100% green and eye-rejected. Rung F went 9/9 + 4/4 green and was playtest-rejected.
laws.scope_measured: Path-D wall arc plus the Rung C-F record
laws.scope_applied: prefabs.toml / donors.toml status discipline: candidate -> qualified only by a walk

laws.name: S5, THE APPROACH-GROUND LAW (no ramp, no lift mound)
laws.statement: At a wall foot, stock ground is a short lip and then a LEVEL TERRACE ~1.0-1.5u over the local lowland. It is never a ramp, and 0 of 176 components are pedestals. BURY and LIFT-with-falloff (a monotone radial mound) are both off-language. 'Any next build is a DELETION.'
laws.evidence: 176 stock wall-foot components; the coarsening A/B (the raised-grass bank survives coarsening, so the lift field carries it)
laws.scope_measured: The Path-D carried wall on a flat host (one bench)
laws.scope_applied: Stated as a general prescription, yet world-mountain still mints a grass apron lift (MTN_GBLEND 12u, --max-apron-lift opt-in) on all 7 qualified massifs

laws.name: THE ONE-WINDOW-PER-TRI LAW + THE ZERO-UV-AREA FLOOR
laws.statement: Every stock tri takes ONE (quad, ori) tile window keyed on its centroid cell, and stock never collapses a tri's UVs (0/14,288). Synthesized ground must emit all 3 UVs from the centroid cell's window.
laws.evidence: Rung F's UV forensics: 2305 one-texel tris made the 'flat green sheets'
laws.scope_measured: 6 stock strata, Rung F build
laws.scope_applied: texgates.py, WARN by default at verify_landmass and transplant

laws.name: THE DUNES SIZE CLASS / DUNES-BACKING LAW
laws.statement: The only grass|desert junction in stock is a <=5-cell topo-16 skin backing onto a >=130-cell dunes complex (143 cells). Topo-17 never shares an edge with grass. So a dunes or mixed-biome unit has a size floor: a small dunes mint 'quilts'.
laws.evidence: n=1 site map-wide (n_components=1, 193 shared edges in (13-15,11-12)). 'Every primary ceiling is n=1.'
laws.scope_measured: One stock site
laws.scope_applied: No small dunes prefab (PREFABS.md:65); the capability manifest constraint 'dunes SIZE CLASS >=~130-cell'

laws.name: THE COMPOSITION FOOTPRINT LAW
laws.statement: Anchor clearance radii (Uaho 35.0u, crag 48.7u), plus a line long enough that dressing stays a minority, plus the coast standoff (the ecotone >=39.95u from the coast), need more area than a small island has. Mixed-biome needs a LARGE landmass (4x4+ blocks).
laws.evidence: Rungs C and D rejected by the offline eye and falsifier with zero playtests (D: an r72 lobe's ecotone-to-rim ceiling vs the measured floor)
laws.scope_measured: Rungs C/D on small and r72 sites
laws.scope_applied: Any mixed-biome composition. SYNTHESIS-RECONSIDERED: the binding variable is FOOTPRINT, not isolation.

laws.name: THE LAND-FIT LAW (carry frame clearance)
laws.statement: A coast carry needs 2u of sea between its land (seabed included) and the rect frame. Land wider than the rect less 4u on either axis can never fit.
laws.evidence: C16: 12 of 30 carry checks refused land-fit; two listed donors (desert-beach (20,5), sandy-coast (18,15)) always refuse

laws.scope_applied: The carry card refuses them at once. They remain 'qualified' in donors.toml (for their BEACH_PINS role), so 'qualified' does not mean 'carryable'.

laws.name: Geometry capacity is not binding
laws.statement: Per part: 65,535 verts (21,845 unindexed tris), proven in game. Stock Terrain max is 736-772 tris and the block max 826, so there is ~28x headroom. No LOD or streaming; all 480 blocks are resident, so the budget is whole-map. Ground-query cost scales ~k^3 with refinement.
laws.evidence: capacity NOTES E1-E11 (E1/E4 gap refuted in game, RESULTS section 8); walk_cost_sim x4 = 7x, x16 = 45x
laws.scope_measured: Stock, plus the deployed 285,796 tris (+6.4%)
laws.scope_applied: No verb is bounded by it today. A prefab of 81 files at stock density adds well under 1% to the world.

laws.scope_measured: Disc-1 coastal donors
